ai.prompt: I'm looking at the Solaris UI documentation for {{component}} ({{url}}). Help me understand how to use it. Be ready to explain concepts, give examples, or help debug based on it.

composer.hint: Shift + Enter for a new line. Enter sends.
composer.label: Chat message
composer.note: Compact variant with floating toolbar. Enter submits, Shift + Enter breaks the line.

rich-text-editor.description: Native contenteditable rich text editor with document and composer variants, form-field pills and char count.

document.label: Receipt text
document.note: Field-like variant with fixed toolbar. Type { to insert a form field.

fields.label: Receipt
fields.note: Pills are atomic: Backspace removes the whole field.

installation.note: Install the Solaris UI package and import the rich text editor with Form Field.

rich-text-editor.title: Rich text editor
